I was driving through an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, when the car in front of me stopped more quickly than I

so the claim can be processed, and I am happy to provide any further records or documentation that would help.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
